methodology_notes.certification_readiness_scoring: Score reflects certification % and remaining blockers. 100 = fully certified. <100 = % of items certified (e.g., A-A = 73/75 = 97). Unprocessed sections scored at 75 if no structural blockers, 65 if DL-013 residue present, 20 if majority archived. DL-008 acts as auto-block (but no DL-008-only sections exist — affected items are within certified sections).
methodology_notes.modernization_readiness_scoring: Uses S801 quality tier scores (Gold 90-97, Silver 75-88, Bronze 65-75, Thin 35-55, Archive 20-35). Reflects educational quality: distractor engineering, explanation depth, citation rate, clone density, business realism. Independently assessed — a 100% certified section can score low on modernization (Pack E Thin tier).
methodology_notes.rewrite_urgency_scoring: Inverse of modernization. Factor weights: clone density ×0.4, DL-013 field count ×0.3, explanation thinness (EC<70/citation<10%) ×0.2, DL-008/DL-026 presence ×0.1. Higher score = more urgent rewrite needed. Scale: 90+ Critical, 70-89 High, 40-69 Medium, 20-39 Low, <20 Minimal.
